scope: Standing French Lick Springs Hotel, with the Main, West, Deluxe and North wings, the southeast Annex, connecting ranges, east veranda and Spa Wing.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Section 7 describes the Main and six-storey Annex, two-storey former baths with squat tower, six-storey West Wing with raised center, angled Deluxe Wing, projecting North Wing and connected guest ranges.
The operator locates the Spa Wing, lobby, Spring Wing and separate convention and casino facilities.
The resort describes the early expansion, Spa Wing and later Deluxe and convention additions.
